Two Held in Karnataka for Illegal Baby Adoption

Authorities in Udupi, Karnataka, have arrested four individuals, including a doctor and a nursing home owner, in connection with an alleged illegal baby adoption racket. The arrests were made following the unauthorized possession of a baby girl. The investigation is ongoing.
